datasets.grain: one record per provider-native index series, return variant, currency, methodology version and valid-time interval

pit_contract.decision_time_rule: An index or methodology version is visible only from its official publication/availability time; launch date, base date and back-calculated history never substitute for publication time.
pit_contract.revision_rule: Never overwrite an index name, code, category, return variant or methodology. Close the prior valid interval, append a new version, retain the official document URL/hash, and preserve code aliases and successor/predecessor links.

tables.grain: one discovered index series by asset and coverage capability as of one catalog audit

fields.name: audit_date
fields.description: Catalog audit date.

fields.name: metadata_status
fields.description: Metadata acquisition state.

fields.name: daily_status
fields.description: Official daily-history coverage state.

fields.name: constituent_history_status
fields.description: Historical constituent coverage state; current samples alone are PARTIAL.

fields.name: weight_history_status

quality_gates.rule: Provider-native index identity is unique by provider_id + index_code + return_variant + currency + methodology_version + valid_from, while code aliases never collapse distinct providers or return variants.

Every index discoverable in each approved official catalog must appear in the coverage matrix as OK, PARTIAL, MISSING or BLOCKED; easy-to-download subsets are not allowed to masquerade as full coverage.
Price, total-return and net-total-return variants and currencies are explicit; an unpublished variant is never synthesized inside CORE-09.
Every usable series has a first-party methodology URL/hash, publication/effective time and non-overlapping valid-time versions.
The exact right for automated collection, local retention, cross-project internal sharing and any external redistribution is documented per provider and asset type before quality_status=OK.

known_blockers.description: SSE/CSI/CNI/BSE public sites expose catalog and detail pages, but a stable documented machine-readable full-catalog export and its automation terms are not confirmed. Official entrances: https://www.sse.com.cn/market/sseindex/indexlist/ ; https://www.csindex.com.cn/ ; https://www.cnindex.com.cn/module/index-detail.html ; https://www.bse.cn/nq/quotation.html
known_blockers.required_resolution: Run per-provider metadata pilot using only documented public downloads/endpoints; record terms, response evidence and catalog totals before bulk discovery.

known_blockers.description: Index metadata, methodology documents, real-time values, end-of-day history and constituent weights have different rights. SSE allows non-commercial browsing/download but requires permission for real-time values and constituent weights; CNI data products may require an agreement/fee; BSE market-data use is licensed.
known_blockers.required_resolution: Complete a field-level rights matrix from https://www.sse.com.cn/home/legal/ , https://www.sse.com.cn/lawandrules/sselawsrules2025/trade/universal/c/c_20250612_10781702.shtml , https://www.cnindex.com.cn/zh_services/data_licensing/index.html?act_menu=4&act_service=3 and https://www.bse.cn/application/guide.html.

datasets.grain: one constituent membership interval, rebalance event or officially timestamped weight observation per index series and security

pit_contract.decision_time_rule: Membership and weights become knowable at official available_at, but become economically valid only at effective_at/weight_as_of. Backtests must apply both clocks and may never use a current constituent list to reconstruct prior periods.
pit_contract.revision_rule: Append corrections as new revision_id records, preserve the superseded payload and source hash, and never rewrite a prior membership interval or weight observation in place.

fields.name: adjustment_type
fields.description: Reason/type of sample change.

fields.name: announced_at

fields.name: effective_at
fields.description: Official sample-change effective timestamp.

fields.name: valid_from
fields.description: Membership interval start, normally equal to effective_at.

fields.name: valid_to
fields.description: Exclusive membership interval end.

fields.name: source_event_id
fields.description: Stable identifier for the official rebalance/adjustment announcement.

fields.name: announced_at

fields.name: is_complete_weight_set

quality_gates.rule: Current sample lists and current weights cannot populate any prior effective interval.
Every usable membership/weight record has both knowledge time and economic valid/as-of time; available_at later than a research decision blocks that record.
Every component resolves to an immutable CORE-01 security_id using code validity at effective_at.
Membership intervals for the same series/security do not overlap after revision resolution, and official add/remove deltas reconcile to the next complete sample set.
Only a source-declared complete weight set is tested against the provider-specified total (normally 1 within 1e-6); partial/top-N lists are never rescaled to 1.
Unavailable official history is explicitly MISSING or BLOCKED_LICENSE per series/date; dataset-level OK never implies universal coverage.

known_blockers.description: Official CSI constituent/weight, corporate-action and divisor feeds require a data licence; the official service states access follows licence approval: https://www.ciis.com.hk/hongkong/sc/idata/csifundamentaldata/index.shtml
known_blockers.required_resolution: Obtain documented internal-research/storage terms or keep CSI historical weights BLOCKED_LICENSE. Public current/top-N displays are not a substitute.

known_blockers.description: SSE index rules require permission/agreement for use of constituent weights: https://www.sse.com.cn/lawandrules/sselawsrules2025/trade/universal/c/c_20250612_10781702.shtml
known_blockers.required_resolution: Document a lawful internal-use entitlement before bulk retention or research use.

known_blockers.description: CNI public detail pages show current samples/weights and historical rebalances, while its official product page treats sample lists, weights and adjustment lists as data services that may require agreement/fees: https://www.cnindex.com.cn/zh_services/data_licensing/index.html?act_menu=4&act_service=3
known_blockers.required_resolution: Confirm exact free historical scope and rights, or mark historical weights/intervals BLOCKED_LICENSE or MISSING by series.

known_blockers.description: BSE publishes current samples and adjustment notices for Northbound 50 and Northbound Specialized and published a limited pre-launch point-history file, but complete historical component weights are not demonstrated; BSE market-data use is permission controlled: https://www.bse.cn/application/guide.html
known_blockers.required_resolution: Use notices for verified membership deltas only after rights review; do not infer full daily weights.

datasets.grain: one versioned industry taxonomy node, one security classification interval, or one explicit crosswalk mapping per classification scheme

pit_contract.decision_time_rule: An industry assignment is usable only after the official result/notice becomes available. Reference period or taxonomy effective date cannot be backdated as the knowledge time. CSRC/CAPCO and Shenwan schemes coexist and are never overwritten into one another.
pit_contract.revision_rule: Append each taxonomy revision, classification release and correction. Preserve the exact official classification code and source release; close prior membership only when an official new result becomes effective.

quality_gates.rule: CSRC/CAPCO and Shenwan assignments are separate records keyed by scheme/version; crosswalks never overwrite original facts.
Codes are unique within scheme/version, parent nodes exist, hierarchy is acyclic and official level semantics are preserved.
Every research-usable assignment has official published_at/available_at and a non-overlapping valid interval; current assignments are never backfilled.
Every assignment resolves to CORE-01 security_id at the release/effective time, including old and delisted codes.
Unknown/unclassified securities remain explicit; missing values are never filled with a current class or another scheme.
Taxonomy and membership copying, retention and cross-project use rights are documented separately for CSRC/CAPCO and Shenwan before quality_status=OK.

known_blockers.description: The CSRC legacy classification-result archive publicly lists quarterly assignments only through 2021 Q3: https://www.csrc.gov.cn/csrc/c100103/common_list.shtml . The 2012 guide is repealed; the current regulator taxonomy is JR/T 0020-2024: https://www.csrc.gov.cn/csrc/c101954/c7520291/content.shtml
known_blockers.required_resolution: Model old CSRC quarterly assignments as a legacy scheme/version; do not treat them as current.

known_blockers.description: Current official company assignments are published half-yearly by the China Association for Public Companies, including 2025 H2 released 2026-04-03: https://www.capco.org.cn/xhgg/hyfl/hyfljg/index.html . CAPCO_OFFICIAL is registered, but automated download, internal retention and historical coverage terms are not yet evidenced.
known_blockers.required_resolution: Record the exact CAPCO result endpoints, terms evidence and available historical issues before ingestion; do not alias CAPCO silently to CSRC_OFFICIAL.

known_blockers.description: The official SW2021 classification report states its copyright is reserved and reproduction/redistribution requires prior written authorization; the public download center does not establish complete PIT company-membership history: https://wxweb.swsresearch.com/swsreport/2021_08/328340.pdf and https://www.swsresearch.com/institute_sw/allIndex/downloadCenter/industryType
known_blockers.required_resolution: Obtain written internal storage/share terms and a first-party PIT membership feed with publication/effective dates, or keep Shenwan membership BLOCKED_LICENSE_AND_PIT.

known_blockers.description: TUSHARE_SECONDARY may only calibrate identifiers and coverage; it cannot replace the official Shenwan source, and token/terms approval has not been granted.
known_blockers.required_resolution: Do not ingest secondary membership until its separate access/licence approval; conflicts always quarantine.

datasets.grain: one official end-of-day observation per provider-native index series, return variant, currency and trade date

pit_contract.decision_time_rule: An end-of-day index value is usable only after its official publication/availability time. A series calculated before its live launch is flagged backcast and cannot be treated as contemporaneously observable before first_publication_at.
pit_contract.revision_rule: Append corrected official observations under a new revision_id, preserve prior values and hashes, and never overwrite or forward-fill a missing trading day.

fields.name: change

fields.name: pct_change

fields.name: aggregate_volume

fields.name: aggregate_amount
fields.description: Aggregated component amount where officially published.

fields.name: calculation_at
fields.description: Official end-of-day calculation timestamp or conservative documented convention.

fields.name: first_publication_at
fields.description: Series-level first official publication time used to identify pre-launch backcast observations.

fields.name: history_regime
fields.description: Whether the observation was published contemporaneously or calculated retrospectively before launch.

fields.name: observation_status
fields.description: Official/factual observation status.

quality_gates.rule: Every bar resolves to exactly one CORE-09 series/methodology valid at trade_date; provider codes, currencies and return variants are explicit.
Close is finite and positive; absent OHLC/volume fields remain NULL and are never imputed from close or component data.
When OHLC are published, high >= max(open,close), low <= min(open,close), high >= low; volume/amount are nonnegative under provider-native units.
Price, total-return and net-total-return levels remain separate official observations; variant return relationships are checked but never forced by overwriting.
available_at is after calculation/publication, and pre-launch observations are explicitly BACKCAST; PIT research cannot treat them as contemporaneously known.
Expected dates follow the series' official market/calendar; gaps, suspensions and non-publication are explicit and never forward-filled.
Joint-publisher/exchange observations agree within the declared rounding tolerance; conflicts quarantine the exact series/date and are not majority-voted.
Automated historical collection, retention and internal cross-project research use are licensed/documented for each provider before quality_status=OK.

known_blockers.description: Public pages show index charts/downloads, but rights for systematic full-history local retention are not uniform. SSE non-commercial website use does not override separate index/market-data rights; CNI calls index points and sample data data-service products; BSE states market-data use is licensed.
known_blockers.required_resolution: Before bulk history, document exact end-of-day rights for every provider/series and keep real-time data out of this daily contract.

known_blockers.description: Official public pages do not yet prove a stable complete daily export for every discovered index and return variant. CNI detail exposes daily/weekly/monthly history; SSE quote pages expose current fields; BSE exposes K-lines and a limited Northbound 50 pre-launch history notice.
known_blockers.required_resolution: Produce a per-series coverage report with first/last date, gaps, variants, live/backcast boundary and official download evidence; unsupported series remain MISSING or BLOCKED_ACCESS.

known_blockers.description: Many official index histories start at a base date before launch, including BSE Northbound 50 history from 2022-04-29 published only in November 2022: https://www.bse.cn/bse_indices_news/200013831.html?flag=bse_bz50
known_blockers.required_resolution: Store first_publication_at/history_regime and make research policy reject pre-publication observations unless the run explicitly permits documented backcast benchmarks.
